facts.text: The user wants Malaysia's Civil Aviation Authority (CAAM) transformed to include global standards and aviation best practices.
The user states that CAAM currently relies predominantly on government grants.
The user wants CAAM transformed into a profitable corporation.
The user wants CAAM to adopt a new mission, vision, and core values.
The user identifies four objectives for the project.
The user wants to establish a world-class aviation authority by strengthening CAAM's current human capital practices and financial management.
The user wants to increase CAAM's workforce capability through inculcation of a high-performance culture.
The user wants CAAM to use targeted and structured learning and development.
The user wants CAAM to improve HR service delivery through a comprehensive human resource framework.
The user wants CAAM to achieve financial independence, stability, and sustainability.
The user wants CAAM to strengthen its financial management to achieve financial independence, stability, and sustainability.
The user wants CAAM to adopt industry-recognized reporting standards.
The user wants CAAM to grow and sustain its air safety and security-related services at a higher level.
The user wants CAAM to achieve the higher level of air safety and security-related services through improvements to CAAM's human resource and financial management frameworks.
The user asks for an in-depth 5-year strategic plan for CAAM to utilize.
The user states there will be a stakeholder engagement session with internal and external stakeholders.
The user wants questions for external stakeholders including leaders of the Malaysian aviation industry and relevant ministries.
The user wants questions for internal stakeholders.
The user asks to conduct a gap analysis between Malaysia's Civil Authority and a reputable civil authority ranked highly by ICAO.

keyphrases: ICAO ranked civil authority gap analysis
